zh-CN: 修复重启或磁盘重新挂载后，原项目仍在却无法打开的问题
原项目移动或暂时不可读时保留记录，避免误打开同 ID 的备份
打开失败显示简短中文提示，不增加弹窗
en: Fix opening existing recent projects after a restart or disk remount
Keep unavailable project entries and avoid opening a backup with the same project ID
Show concise project-opening errors without additional dialogs
